tasks.label: gates: api
tasks.command: cargo fmt --check && infisical run --path=/api -- cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && infisical run --path=/api -- cargo build && infisical run --path=/api -- cargo sqlx prepare --workspace --check && cargo deny check && infisical run --path=/api -- cargo llvm-cov nextest --fail-under-lines 100 --fail-under-functions 100 --fail-under-regions 100

tasks.label: gates: site
tasks.command: bun audit && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build && bun check && bun run test

tasks.label: gates: web
tasks.command: bun audit && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run build && bun check && bun run test

tasks.label: gates: mobile
tasks.command: flutter analyze --fatal-infos && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed . && very_good test --coverage --min-coverage 100 --collect-coverage-from=all --test-randomize-ordering-seed random
